title: Inferred Timing Range
notes: Removes the manual Timing Fill direction selector.
Uses the first tapped hole as the origin and the second tapped hole as the endpoint.
Infers left, right, down, or up from the two taps and fills only between them.
Rejects diagonal endpoints that do not share the origin hole's row or column.
Skips Dirt and Bad holes inside a valid timing range.
Preserves the portrait iPad Hole Entry clipped-controls repair.
Adds Page Order / Renumber under Shot Diagram Page Tools.
Renumbers pages in report order while preserving every sheet's canvas position.
Does not change Firebase rules, cloud revision handling, calculations, imports, or document formats.
